train_one_epoch_ex: run one epoch of CLIP model training with gradient clipping and checkpoint saving
evaluate_ex: run zero-shot and validation evaluation on the CLIP model and log metrics
build_loss: build a CLIP loss function instance with distributed training configuration
get_metrics: compute image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval metrics including mean rank and recall
AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter to track running average and current values during training
